title: Scallion-Gochujang Grilled Oysters
shortDescription: Live oysters are grilled in their shells until they open, then topped with a separately prepared scallion-gochujang sauce and cooked until bubbling.
culturalContext: This scallion-gochujang grilled oyster is a contemporary Korean-inspired preparation. Oyster species, harvest controls, sauce balance, and grill practice vary and require seafood and cultural review.
author: {{LEGAL_NAME}}
equipment: Outdoor grill or manufacturer-approved indoor electric grill

instructions.heading: Verify source and shells
instructions.action: Retain the harvest tag, keep oysters cold, and discard cracked shells or open shells that do not close when tapped.
instructions.visualOrTactileCue: Only live responsive oysters with intact shells remain.
instructions.safetyNote: Do not cook or eat dead, cracked, untagged, or temperature-abused oysters.

instructions.heading: Scrub safely
instructions.action: Scrub shells under cool running water with a dedicated clean brush; do not soak in fresh water.
instructions.visualOrTactileCue: Shell exteriors are free of visible debris.
instructions.safetyNote: Sanitize the sink and brush after raw-shellfish contact.

instructions.heading: Mix topping separately
instructions.action: Combine gochujang, rice syrup, vinegar, scallions, garlic, and sesame oil in a clean bowl.
instructions.visualOrTactileCue: Topping is smooth and remains free of raw-shellfish contact.
instructions.safetyNote: Verify gochujang, soy, wheat/gluten, and sesame allergens.

instructions.heading: Grill until open
instructions.action: Place oysters cupped-side down on the hot tray, cover, and grill until shells open.
instructions.safetyNote: Discard every oyster that does not open; do not pry it open to eat.

instructions.heading: Top and finish
instructions.action: Using clean tongs, remove top shells from opened oysters, add a small amount of topping, and grill until the topping bubbles and oyster is fully hot.
instructions.visualOrTactileCue: Topping bubbles and oyster flesh is firm and opaque.
instructions.safetyNote: Avoid shell cuts, hot steam, and spilled liquor.

instructions.heading: Serve promptly
instructions.action: Transfer opened cooked oysters to a clean platter and serve immediately.
instructions.visualOrTactileCue: Only opened oysters are on the clean platter.
instructions.safetyNote: At-risk diners should never receive raw or undercooked oysters.

grillSetup: Use an outdoor grill or approved indoor electric grill with a stable heat-safe tray over medium-high heat; keep raw and cooked shellfish tools separate.
targetInternalTemperature: Cook until shells open; discard any that do not open. After topping, cook until oyster flesh is firm and opaque and the sauce bubbles.
foodSafetyNotes: Buy tagged live oysters from a certified source and keep cold.
Discard cracked, dead, unresponsive, or non-opening oysters.
Cook thoroughly; never serve raw or undercooked oysters in this draft.
Prevent raw-shellfish cross-contact and shell/steam injuries.

allergens.crossContactWarning: Contains shellfish, soy, wheat/gluten, and sesame; verify the gochujang label.

substitutions: Do not substitute pre-shucked oysters without a separately validated process.
ingredientSourcing: Buy tagged live oysters from a reputable certified dealer and retain the tag as required.
makeAhead: Buy and cook live shellfish the same day when possible; prepare topping separately and refrigerate.
storage: Refrigerate cooked shellfish in a shallow covered container within 2 hours and use within 2 days pending qualified review.
reheating: Reheat only the needed portion until steaming; discard any shellfish held unsafely.
leftovers: Use only properly refrigerated leftovers within the approved window.
servingSuggestions: Serve hot with rice and fresh banchan.

faq.question: Can I eat an oyster that stays closed?
faq.answer: No. Discard every shell that does not open during cooking.

faq.question: Can these be served lightly cooked?
faq.answer: No. This draft requires thorough cooking.

buyingCues: Buy live shellfish from a reputable certified source with required tag or label information.
Shells are closed or close when tapped; discard cracked shells and nonresponsive open shells.
Product is cold, smells fresh and mild, and was not stored in fresh water.
seafoodPreparation.thawing: Not applicable; use live shellfish. Do not freeze or thaw live shellfish for this draft.
seafoodPreparation.cleaningOrShellPreparation: Scrub closed responsive shells under cool running water with a dedicated brush; discard cracked or nonresponsive shells and do not shuck before the opening cook.
seafoodPreparation.drying: Drain well after scrubbing; do not soak live shellfish in fresh water.
seafoodPreparation.grillSurfacePreparation: Preheat a stable heat-safe grill tray over medium-high heat.
seafoodPreparation.stickingPrevention: Keep shellfish on the tray in their shells so juices remain contained.
seafoodPreparation.approximateTime: 8 to 10 minutes, controlled by shell opening and product-specific guidance.
seafoodPreparation.shellOpeningAndDiscardGuidance: Cook until shells open during cooking and discard every shell that does not open; never pry open a non-opening shell to eat it.
crossContactNotes: Keep live raw shellfish and their liquids away from ready-to-eat foods.
Wash hands and sanitize sink, brush, and utensils after raw-shellfish contact.
Use clean tongs and a clean platter for opened cooked shellfish.
